newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-News wants freer Australian markets.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-News wants freer Australian markets.

text.p: News Ltd, the Australian unit of global media group News Corp Ltd, said on Tuesday that it encouraged greater deregulation of Australian media markets.

"Our submission encourages liberalising all regulations restricting ownership of the media market in order to increase competition and diversity of opinion, thereby better serving the interests of consumes," chairman Ken Cowley said in the company's submission to the Australian government's inquiry into cross-media ownership. The government will determine if regulations which prevent significant ownership of print and electronic media should be eased, or scrapped.

"Rapid technological change is blurring the lines between various facets of media, making it counter-productive for government to attempt to create artificial barriers between different segments of the media industry," Cowley said.

The newspaper operations of News Ltd account for more than 50 percent of Australia's metropolitan readership while the parent company owns the maximum permissible stake of 15 percent in the Seven Network Ltd television group.
News Corp is also a partner in the pay television group Foxtel with the state-owned telecom group Telstra Corp.
News Corp also owns five percent of newspaper publisher John Fairfax Holdings Ltd.
